body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Tiny commander with enormous confidence; spirited short declarations, never genuinely aggressive. Voice direction: Light male tenor speaking fluent English with a French accent. Rolling musical phrasing, pointed consonants and controlled theatrical confidence. Nimble, dashing and decisive rather than pompous. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Hold that position! The defender moves, and the piece is lost. Check the reply first; a confident move still needs a solid reason.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
